recipes.name: Apple Crisp
recipes.source: Sample recipe, replaced on first sync
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F and butter a 9×13-inch baking dish.
Toss the apples with the sugar, lemon juice and cinnamon. Spread them in the dish.
Rub the oats, flour, brown sugar and butter together until clumpy. Scatter over the apples.
Bake until bubbling and golden, about 45 minutes. Cool 10 minutes before serving.
notes: Serve warm with vanilla ice cream.

recipes.name: Chicken Piccata

ingredientGroups.label: Chicken
items: 3 large boneless, skinless chicken breasts (about 2¼ lb)

ingredientGroups.label: Sauce
items: ⅓ cup fresh lemon juice (about 2 lemons)

steps: Start the pasta water. Cook the pasta while the chicken cooks, and reserve ½ cup of the pasta water before draining.
Slice each breast in half horizontally into 6 cutlets. Pound them to an even ¼-inch thickness.
Season the cutlets with the salt and pepper, then dredge them in flour and shake off the excess.

Heat 1½ tbsp oil and 1 tbsp butter in a 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat. Cook 3 cutlets until golden, 3–4 min per side. Move them to a plate. Repeat with the remaining oil, another 1 tbsp butter and the other 3 cutlets.
Lower the heat to medium. Add the garlic and cook 30 seconds.
Add the broth, lemon juice and capers, scraping up the browned bits. Simmer until reduced by about a third, 5–6 min.
Turn off the heat and swirl in the last 2 tbsp butter. Return the chicken and spoon the sauce over it. Sprinkle with parsley.
Toss the pasta with a few spoonfuls of the sauce, loosening it with pasta water as needed. Serve the chicken on top.
notes: Feeding 7+: use 4 breasts (8 cutlets) and 1½ times the sauce. Cook the chicken in 3 batches.
Kids: halve the capers, or leave them on the side.
Swap: chicken thighs work. Cook them 5–6 min per side.
Make-ahead: pound and flour the cutlets up to 4 hours ahead. Refrigerate them on a sheet pan.

recipes.name: Lemon Ricotta Pancakes
recipes.source: Sample recipe, replaced on first sync
steps: Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt in a large bowl.
In another bowl, whisk the ricotta, milk, eggs, lemon zest and juice until smooth.
Fold the wet ingredients into the dry until just combined. A few lumps are fine.
Cook ⅓-cup scoops on a buttered griddle over medium heat, about 2 min per side.

recipes.name: Slow Cooker Pot Roast
recipes.source: Sample recipe, replaced on first sync
steps: Season the roast all over with the salt and pepper. Brown it on all sides in a hot skillet, if you have time.
Put the potatoes, carrots and onion in the slow cooker. Set the roast on top.
Pour in the broth and Worcestershire. Cook on low 8 hours, until the beef pulls apart.
notes: Thicken the juices with a cornstarch slurry for gravy.
